title: Notices (banner)
description: Persistent banner notices sourced from `@wordpress/notices` (default context). Rendered with `Notice.Root` from `@wordpress/ui`.

documentation.purpose: Renders persistent banner notices (info / warning / success / error) at the top of whatever region pins it. Source: `@wordpress/notices` store, filtered to `type === 'default'`. Any app calling `wp.data.dispatch('core/notices').createNotice(...)` lands here. Dismissible notices show a close icon that fires `removeNotice(id)`.

reads.purpose: Admin-notices harvest (#128): global `admin_notices` HTML buffered server-side by WP_Admin_Shell_Chrome_Harvest. Rendered unchanged (admin trust) inside one neutral Notice.Root, locally dismissible. Global-only — per-screen `$pagenow`-keyed notices don't fire on the shell page.

writes.purpose: Remove a notice on close-icon click — `removeNotice(id)`.

states.when: No default-context notices and no harvested admin_notices HTML
At least one default notice OR harvested HTML present
states.renders: Stack of `Notice.Root` banners (one per notice) + (when present) a neutral banner wrapping the harvested admin_notices HTML.

interactions.trigger: Click close icon on a store notice
Click close icon on the harvested banner
interactions.effect: Local `useState` hides the harvested HTML for the session (no server round-trip).

a11y.screen-reader: `Notice.Root` from `@wordpress/ui` sets ARIA attributes appropriate to the intent (`role="alert"` for error, `role="status"` for info). The harvested banner uses the neutral intent.

constraints.note: Only `type: 'default'` notices land here. `type: 'snackbar'` notices go to `core:notices-snackbar` (separate app, different region).
WordPress's notice `status` field maps to WPDS Notice `intent`: `error` → `error`, `warning` → `warning`, `success` → `success`, `info` → `info`. Unknown statuses fall back to `info`.

`admin_notices` is a per-page-render hook; only GLOBAL notices firing on the shell's own page load are captured (#128). Per-screen notices keyed on `$pagenow`/the current classic screen don't fire and aren't surfaced. Global-only is the accepted interim — proper fix is a notices REST surface (upstream #155).

Harvested `admin_notices` HTML is admin-context (same trust as classic wp-admin), rendered unchanged via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` inside the already-admin-gated workspace. See docs/runtime-harvest-pattern.md → Trust.

design-system-leakage.purpose: Notice.Root + Notice.Description + Notice.Actions + Notice.CloseIcon — banner primitives.
